To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 07 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed 'Core Serving' Pod Merge & Sensitive Role Transitions

Team — attaching a short rationale and a transition matrix for a proposed consolidation of our Core Serving and Edge Serving pods into a single "Core Serving" pod. High-level goals: reduce manager span overlap, simplify deployment ownership, and create clearer upward career paths for infra ICs.

Why now: utilization across the two pods has drifted to similar workloads; we have duplicate on-call rotations and three managers with 8-12 direct reports each which has led to uneven performance reviews and managerial burnout. The attached transition_matrix.xlsx maps each role and proposed new manager.

Immediate asks:
- Please review the rationale (reorg_rationale.pdf) and matrix and flag any hard constraints (ongoing contracts, active performance plans).
- Karthik / Jonas: we need a people-safety read from PeopleOps before any comms. I’ve looped PeopleOps consulting and Evan (legal) in the thread for an initial check on timing and severability clauses.
- Marcus / Aditya: finalize manager talking points and identify 1:1s that should be held privately before a public announcement.

Confidentiality: this is strictly leadership/manager level until we confirm transitions are legally/operationally safe.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: reorg_rationale.pdf (summary, 4 pages), transition_matrix.xlsx (role-level mapping), manager_talking_points.docx (draft)

I'll add inline comments to transition_matrix.xlsx. PeopleOps should confirm whether we can start private 1:1s this month or if we need a longer freeze.

Mina / all — I walked the matrix with the tech leads. Operational risks: 
- On-call: consolidated pager rotations will increase mean pages per engineer by ~15% unless we rebalance shifts — propose an interim 10% capacity buffer for 8 weeks.
- Knowledge transfer: two critical components (kv-cache and quantization pipeline) are currently owned exclusively by Edge engineers. We should require explicit transfer tasks in owners' JIRA before reassignment.

People risks — from my perspective the sensitive part is manager-to-manager workload balance. We can avoid layoffs if we accept slower hiring in Q2 and move a small number of “stretch” tickets to cross-team pools. However, if Finance is cutting comp, we may not have flexibility.

Action items I can take: draft the manager 1:1 outline, and create a short KT checklist for handoffs.

—Jonas
Head of Platform Programs

Hi Mina / leadership — thanks for the materials. A few legal/PeopleOps flags we recommend before any manager-level 1:1s: 
1) Employment terms review: we need HR to confirm whether role title changes or reporting-line changes trigger notice/consultation requirements in EU (we can support a region-specific memo).
2) Performance plans: do not move or reassign employees on active PIPs until PeopleOps has completed a handoff plan; these cases require careful documentation.
3) Manager communications: managers should not make commitments on compensation changes or severance without written sign-off from HR and Legal.

We propose a short timeline: 2 business days for a legal read, 3 business days for PeopleOps to prepare private 1:1 scripts and offer language. If you want, we can run manager role-play sessions (remote) next week.

Best,
Maya Kline (PeopleOps Consulting)
People Operations Consultant

Adding comms perspective — draft redlines below for manager_talking_points.docx: 
- Opening line: "This is an operational consolidation to improve reliability and career clarity — no decision on headcount has been made." (we should not promise no layoffs unless Finance confirms).
- Private 1:1s: managers should lead with role clarity and expected KT steps; defer any comp-specific language to HR/PeopleOps.
- All-hands: recommend waiting until 72 hours after private 1:1s have started so managers have had a chance to surface issues.

Also: recommend a neutral FAQ doc in Drive answering questions about benefits, performance cycles, and timeline; I can draft.

Aditya
